snippet.description:
On Friday, a groundstop became the longest closure of US airspace since 9/11. Now people are left wondering: How do we make sure this doesn’t happen again? Vox’s Sara Herschander explains how a change in how we fund the FAA could make modernization and improvements easier.

Read more: https://www.vox.com/future-perfect/510975/faa-air-traffic-control-system-canada-funding
